confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are medium confidence. They rest on search snippets from Numbeo data reproduced by Expatica (June 2026), Frommers, and tablejourney menu-del-dia listings, which are mixed-date and partly blog-sourced. Beer is a bounded estimate from those snippets. Cocktail and wine_glass are weak: no reliable 2026 cocktail or wine survey was found, so cocktail was set at roughly three times the beer anchor and wine_glass from pintxos-bar guidance, and the local price relationship to beer is the disclosed basis. The menu-del-dia range (about EUR 13-18) is taken from guides, and a late-2026 article suggests lunch prices have risen, so inexp_meal_1p may be low. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context for a July 2026 peak-season window. They were not checked against live booking pages or current listings, and hotel_1star_2p and hostel_private_2p carry the widest uncertainty. The FX observation is the RBA 4.00 pm rate as at 18 November 2026, taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as shown in search results; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basque coastal tourist cities with similar pintxos-bar and restaurant pricing (Bilbao, Biarritz-type southwestern Europe), adjusted upward for San Sebastian's July peak-season demand and reported premium over the Spanish average.
